description: This file implements a greedy memory allocation strategy for tensor memory planning in PyTorch's native runtime, specifically the 'GreedyBySize' algorithm. It defines data structures and functions to sort allocation specifications, compute memory offsets, and generate a memory layout plan.

classes.name: GreedyAllocation
classes.description: Tracks individual memory allocations, maintaining original order and associated specification indices.

classes.name: AllocationSpecWithIndex
classes.description: Associates an allocation specification with its original index for sorting purposes.

methods.name: prepare_allocation_specs
methods.description: Sorts allocation specifications in descending order by size, associating each with its original index.

methods.name: GreedyBySizeAllocationPlanner
methods.description: Main function implementing the greedy memory allocation planning algorithm based on size.
